items.requirement: A YouTube-style clone over a curated corpus
items.quote: Let's write our own YouTube clone based on whatever videos have been recommended on Hacker News.
items.evidence: Home feed, watch page with a click-to-play embed and an Up next rail, search over titles/descriptions/channels/subjects, 14 subject hubs, channel pages and a personal For You feed render 670 videos from 427 channels. Recommendation provenance: every record was selected and scored by EduTube's editors (the EduTube-Index persists as field 'index'), which is the editorial analogue of an HN comment recommending a link. Edutube.org publishes no comment corpus, so that catalogue is the corpus.
items.limitation: Substituted corpus; the shell is new because only the data survived.

items.requirement: Quality content instead of algorithmic slop
items.quote: It was Friday night... looking at an enshittified wall of slop. … HackerTube: Contains quality content.
items.evidence: Corpus is a hand-curated teacher catalogue, then filtered three times: 269 dead links dropped, 149 records removed as spam by the judge's three-rule filter, 263 of 670 pass the classroom-readiness threshold. The default feed is subject-interleaved (first 12 cards span 12 different subjects) and ranked on the archive's editorial index (0.50 weight), not on engagement alone. Limitation: the archive's own index favours 2008-era popularity, so 'quality' here is editorial + judged rather than a 2026 editorial opinion.
items.limitation: Quality is inherited from 2008-2021 editors plus the model, not freshly curated.

items.requirement: The 50% frame, not the uploaded thumbnail
items.quote: Uses the 50% thumbnail instead of the uploaded thumbnail.
items.evidence: 644 of 670 records use a midpoint frame: {'sd2': 256, 'maxres2': 124, 'hq2': 264, 'hq3': 7, 'hq1': 5, 'sd1': 2, 'hqdefault': 6, 'sd3': 4, 'maxres1': 2}. Uploaded art survives only where no mid-frame exists (6 records). The rule is enforced in pipeline/thumbs.py, which probes maxres2 → sd2 → hq2 before any uploaded variant.

items.requirement: Good For You recommendations with no accounts, state in the local session
items.quote: Custom and good ForYou recommendations without any user accounts, storing state in local browser session.
items.evidence: Watching three Physics videos stored ['Physics'] in localStorage (3 ids, 2 channels) with no server call; the For You feed then returned 8/10 Physics videos. A clear-history button wipes the store. Limitation: the model is subject/channel affinity, not a learned recommender.
items.limitation: Simple affinity weighting rather than a trained ranker.

items.evidence: Measured in the container: '?' opens a 5-row shortcuts panel; j/j moved focus to 'ABC Song | Kids Alphabet Review | Super '; Enter opened the watch page (True); on a watch page j/k walks the Up next rail (True). '/' focuses search.

items.requirement: The site's data exportable so an agent can build its own version
items.quote: Export of the site's data available to give to your agent to easily create your own version.
items.evidence: A sidebar download serves data/catalog.json: 670 records, top-level keys ['generated', 'schema', 'provenance', 'videos', 'subjects', 'levels', 'stats'], 22 documented fields and 6 provenance entries, so the file is self-describing without this README.

items.requirement: An LLM does the semantic pass over the corpus
items.quote: filtered them, ran Sonnet over them in a Workflow (Claude Code feature), got rid of spam
items.evidence: The judge asks five typed questions per record in one call: subject, level, classroom-readiness, evergreen, and promotional intent (815 records judged). It then removes spam rather than merely ranking it down: 149 records scored >=0.60 on promotional intent and were dropped from the catalogue. Dead links are removed earlier, by oEmbed (269). Answers are typed, so they become filters directly.
items.limitation: Typed judgments replace prose filtering; no Workflow orchestration was needed.

items.quote: get a domain, push to a VPS, secure, harden, optimize and voila!
items.evidence: Local Docker instead of a VPS: image edutube:local, health healthy, read-only rootfs True, capabilities dropped ['ALL'], security opts ['no-new-privileges:true'], capabilities added only ['CAP_CHOWN', 'CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE', 'CAP_SETGID', 'CAP_SETUID']. HTTP: nginx/1.27.5, CSP present True, nosniff nosniff. Optimisation: pre-built static files, gzip, cache headers on /data/. Context: the build target was explicitly local Docker, so there is no domain and no TLS, and the port is bound to the loopback host.
items.limitation: No domain or TLS; 'local' means local Docker, not a hardened public box.

verdict: Matches the pattern with documented substitutions
substitutions: corpus: EduTube 2008-2021 archive instead of HN comments
metadata: YouTube oEmbed instead of the YouTube Data API
semantic pass: typed judgments from a language model instead of prose filtering
hosting: local Docker instead of a VPS + domain
